An editable install lets edits to an ada: An editable install lets edits to an adapter's Python sources take effect on the next restart, instead of only after reinstalling. 'Automatic' turns it on for adapters whose directory is a symlink or junction, which is how a working copy is linked into an installation.
Creates a venv as soon as a Python adapt: Creates a venv as soon as a Python adapter is installed whose environment is missing.
Every Python adapter will be stopped, it: Every Python adapter will be stopped, its environment rebuilt and the adapter started again. This takes a few seconds per adapter and needs internet access.
Leave empty to search PATH. uv ships its: Leave empty to search PATH. uv ships its own interpreters, which avoids depending on an outdated system Python.
Looks for uv, a writable environment dir: Looks for uv, a writable environment directory, internet access and the state of every installed Python adapter. Changes nothing.
Rebuilds every Python environment from s: Rebuilds every Python environment from scratch, picking up the newest Python SDK. Each adapter is stopped while its environment is replaced and started again afterwards.
This adapter manages Python environments: This adapter manages Python environments. Processes are started by js-controller.
uv creates the virtual environments and: uv creates the virtual environments and brings its own Python interpreters. If it is not installed, this adapter fetches a pinned version into iobroker-data/py/.bin/.
